From:
Ismith@bakeandtakeacademy.com
To:
snovak@vezzadiner.com
Subject:
Class Update
Date:
February 10
Dear Ms. Novak,
We regret to inform you that the cake decoration class you registered for has been
canceled.
We hope you will consider enrolling for our summer class. Your e-mail address is now in
our database, so I will make sure you are notified of our summer schedule as soon as it is
finalized. I should mention that Bake-and-Take Academy also offers private classes by
certified pastry chefs all year round to fit your schedule. Let me know if you would like
further information on this option.
We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.
Best,
Lisa Smith
Bake-and-Take Academy Class Coordinator
